description: Put a note back to a version from its History. The note as it stands is saved to History first, so a restore is undone by restoring that one. Tell the user which version, from when, before calling this.

note_id.description: Note id, as returned by search_notes or list_notes.

version_id.description: A version id, as returned by list_versions.

name: scratchpad_restore_version
title: Restore version
